cuts.head: tilt
cuts.ofreeRecent: a Han-era inn — holds her keepsake at chest height; a sunny concrete skate park of smooth bowls and ramps — frames a shot on a smartphone held out in both hands; a beach club of white daybeds and parasols on the sand — holds her keepsake up beside her face; a dark jellyfish room — slips the corner of a freshly printed instant photo into an album; a sunlit white marble temple — standing and leaning her upper body forward toward the camera from the hips; a cinema lobby with a popcorn counter — crouching down low; a small open pavilion with upturned eaves perched on a sheer mountain cliff above a sea of clouds — sitting on the ground; a calligraphy classroom with low wooden desks — standing and leaning her upper body forward toward the camera from the hips; a beach club of white daybeds and parasols on the sand — leans her forearms over a swim ring floating in the water; high above a dense bamboo forest — standing; a stage under a painted night sky of crystal stars — perched on a ledge or edge; a Guan Yu temple — standing and leaning her upper body forward toward the camera from the hips; a giant spinning teacup ride — holds her keepsake in both hands in front of her
